items.text: The tilcayo , a new species of tiger cat, is formally identified.
Former leader of Kosovo Hashim Thaçi is sentenced to twenty-five years in prison for war crimes during his leadership of the Kosovo Liberation Army.
At the Primetime Emmy Awards, Widow's Bay wins Outstanding Comedy Series, and The Pitt wins Outstanding Drama Series.
